prompt_sections.description: [WIDE SHOT] The Obsidian stands on a stone balcony overlooking a storm-swept city at dusk. His tightly coiled afro catches the last amber light. Left cheek gold scar glowing faintly. He grips the obsidian-edged balcony rail with both hands, knuckles white. One slow, deep exhale as lightning flickers behind him. His black-and-gold armor shifts with the movement.
prompt_sections.soundscape: distant thunder rolling, wind gusting across stone, heavy fabric rustling, a single low rumble of lightning
prompt_sections.avoid: turning around, camera movement, hands touching face, clothes appearing or morphing, subject rotation, multiple visible actions

pipeline_config.identity_spec: dark deep-brown Black male, tightly coiled high-volume afro, left cheek gold scar, glowing amber left eye, black and gold armor cape, rugged masculine build

prompt_sections.description: [MEDIUM SHOT] Continuation. The Obsidian turns his head slightly to the right, a slow deliberate motion, scanning the horizon. Amber eye tracks something distant. His jaw tightens. Wind whips the edge of his cape.
prompt_sections.soundscape: wind strengthening, thunder closer now, cape snapping, distant rain beginning
